items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: and then we met Louis Jordan

ctx.x: Don Alvin, yeah, we met them out there and then we met Louis Jordan. He was with the Rabbit Foot Minister and we met Jimmy Pryor's orchestra. You understand? Jimmy Pryor? Yeah, from Alvarado, his piano player. You understand what I mean? And Louis Jordan was with him. You understand? And them guys had that wood alcohol, talking about, that old sterno, you know what he was talking about, you know what he was talking about, blowing the poison off it and all that kind of stuff. And we met them out there. And then…
Who were these guys you were playing with on the board?
